# Python SDK reference (`meshforge.sdk`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_api_docs.py from meshforge.sdk docstrings. DO NOT EDIT. -->

```text
User-facing Python SDK imported inside user programs.

Will provide ``remote_gpu()`` (Mode 2), ``combined_gpu()`` (Mode 4),
``RemoteModule``/``RemoteTensor``, the work-queue client (Mode 3) and planner
placement requests (ARCHITECTURE §20). Allowed imports: ``meshforge.common``
only, so it stays installable without the ``controller``/``agent`` extras; it
talks to the fabric over the network, never by importing ``controller``,
``agent``, ``gpu_service`` or ``cli``.
```

**No public names in this release.** The in-program library (`remote_gpu()`, `combined_gpu()`, remote tensors) belongs to Mode 2 / Mode 4, deferred by [ADR-0012](../adr/0012-scope-ship-mode3-complete.md). Programs use the fabric through the `compute` CLI's `--json` output ([../user/sdk-quickstart.md](../user/sdk-quickstart.md), [cli.md](cli.md)).
